Hello,
I am running a second order CFA using the code:

model_MPFI_1 <- 'ACCEPTANCE =~ MPFI_A1 + MPFI_A2 + MPFI_A3 + MPFI_A4 + MPFI_A5  
PRESENT_MOMENT_AWARENESS =~ MPFI_CH1 + MPFI_CH2 + MPFI_CH3 + MPFI_CH4 + MPFI_CH5
SELF_AS_CONTEXT =~ MPFI_JA1 + MPFI_JA2 + MPFI_JA3 + MPFI_JA4 + MPFI_JA5
DEFUSION =~ MPFI_D1 + MPFI_D2 + MPFI_D3 + MPFI_D4 + MPFI_D5
VALUES =~ MPFI_W1 + MPFI_W2 + MPFI_W3 + MPFI_W4 + MPFI_W5  
COMMITED_ACTION =~ MPFI_ZD1 + MPFI_ZD2 + MPFI_ZD3 + MPFI_ZD4 + MPFI_ZD5
EXPERIENTIAL_AVOIDANCE =~ MPFI_U1 + MPFI_U2 + MPFI_U3 + MPFI_U4 + MPFI_U5
LACK_OF_PRESENT_MOMENT_AWARENESS =~ MPFI_BCH1 + MPFI_BCH2 + MPFI_BCH3 + MPFI_BCH4 + MPFI_BCH5
SELF_AS_CONTENT =~ MPFI_SJA1 + MPFI_SJA2 + MPFI_SJA3 + MPFI_SJA4 + MPFI_SJA5
FUSION =~ MPFI_F1 + MPFI_F2 + MPFI_F3 + MPFI_F4 + MPFI_F5
LACK_OF_CONTACT_WITH_VALUES =~ MPFI_BW1 + MPFI_BW2 + MPFI_BW3 + MPFI_BW4 + MPFI_BW5
INACTION =~ MPFI_BEZ1 + MPFI_BEZ2 + MPFI_BEZ3 + MPFI_BEZ4 + MPFI_BEZ5
GLOBAL_FLEXIBILITY =~ ACCEPTANCE + PRESENT_MOMENT_AWARENESS + SELF_AS_CONTEXT + DEFUSION + VALUES + COMMITED_ACTION
GLOBAL_INFLEXIBILITY =~ EXPERIENTIAL_AVOIDANCE + LACK_OF_PRESENT_MOMENT_AWARENESS + SELF_AS_CONTENT + FUSION + LACK_OF_CONTACT_WITH_VALUES + INACTION'

fit_MPFI_1 <- cfa(model_MPFI_1, estimator = "MLM", data = MPFI_CompACT_R, std.lv = TRUE)

Firstly the model did not converge, but std.lv=TRUE helped with that. 
Unfortunately, the results are confusing, as CFI and TLI are low, RMSEA is good, SRMR is unacceptable. What is more, taking a look at the second order factors and factor loadings, the first loadings are pretty low (namely for Acceptance and Experiential avoidance). This is the output:
